title: Decision Table: Lateness Multiple of the Reconnection Deposit under Security Deposits
content:
The lateness multiple of the Residential Credit Reestablishment Deposit assessed under Security Deposits at the reconnection of a Schedule R or Schedule FH account whose waived deposit was reinstated counts the late payment charges billed on that Electric Service by Rate Schedule account in the last twelve months.

## Rule

The reconnection multiple starts from the lateness multiple the account's late payment charges set. At least the high lateness count of **5** late payment charges takes the high lateness multiple of **2.5**; at least the mid lateness count of **3** but fewer than 5 takes the mid lateness multiple of **2.25**; fewer than 3 takes neither of these multiples.

## Decision table

| Late payment charges on the account, last twelve months | Lateness multiple |
|---|---|
| 5 or more | 2.5 |
| 3 or 4 | 2.25 |
| 0, 1 or 2 | neither figure |

## Edges

| Late payment charges | Lateness multiple |
|---|---|
| 5 | 2.5 |
| 4 | 2.25 |
| 3 | 2.25 |
| 2 | neither figure |
